confidence_notes: Restaurant meal anchors rest on Numbeo Dublin figures corroborated by visitor guides (higher confidence). Beer and coffee rest on 2026 guides and crowd-sourced listings, some undated. Cocktail and wine_glass rest on guide ranges, cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.8x beer; wine_glass about 1.35x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic July peak-season estimates from general knowledge; no listings were checked, so they are the weakest part. EUR prices were converted at an assumed approximate 1.14 USD per EUR, not an RBA rate. The 2026-11-18 FX figure came from a third-party page presenting RBA data, found after a first search returned only March 2026 data; I could not confirm it on the rba.gov.au table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy used. Food and drink anchors use Dublin-specific aggregates and guides; accommodation is a holistic Dublin July peak-season estimate.
